title: Device for the adjustment of a raw-edged lens with respect to an outline pattern of its mount

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.note: This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a vacuum generating device or a housing with a grip portion for such a device.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip portion or a hollow body related to a vacuum generating device.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: This reference does not describe a vacuum generating device, exhaust air, or a grip portion through which air is guided.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip portion or a sound-damping device.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: This reference does not describe any of the components of a grip unit as defined.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.note: This reference describes a lens adjustment device, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a suction plate or a grip unit.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip portion or sound-damping material.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: This reference does not describe a vacuum generating device or its arrangement within a housing.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: This reference does not describe a housing portion or a sound-reducing device/material.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip portion, housing portions, or an air outlet.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: This reference does not describe an air collection screw, grip portion, housing portion, or exhaust air.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: This reference does not describe air baffles, a grip portion, exhaust air, or an air outlet.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: This reference does not describe a battery coupling point, housing portion, air baffles, or exhaust air.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit, suction plate, or a coupling device for them.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.note: This reference does not describe a grip unit, suction opening, suction chamber, or suction plate.

overall.why: This reference describes a device for adjusting raw-edged lenses with respect to an outline pattern, which is completely unrelated to a vacuum handling apparatus with a sound-damped grip unit.
